name: Nagato Class Battleship
description: The Nagato battleship completed its initial design in 1916 and was completed and delivered on November 25, 1920. It has been in service for more than 20 years. The battleship not only had the world's largest caliber 8 4-seat dual-mounted 410 mm ship-borne main guns at the time, but also carried 3 seaplanes with a speed of more than 26 knots. Based on naval battle experience, it also strengthened armor defense in key areas to defend against long-distance and large-angle bomb strikes. This battleship with heavy firepower and high speed was regarded as the battleship with the most powerful artillery and the fastest sailing speed in the world at that time.
